_comment: Optional Semantic Scholar API key. Copy this file to s2_config.json (same directory) and paste your key. Get one free at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api. Alternatively set the S2_API_KEY environment variable, which takes precedence. Without a key, Semantic Scholar features still work on the shared public pool but are heavily rate-limited, and search.py --cite-counts is skipped.
